shortBulletSummary: Bitcoin fell below $83K, ETH below $2,500; $1.19B in long positions liquidated across crypto markets.
Rising oil prices, US Treasury yields, and a stronger dollar continue to pressure crypto markets.
Crypto Fear & Greed Index shows 'Greed' at 59, but other indicators suggest 'Bearish' sentiment.
Thailand's SEC approved domestic spot Bitcoin and Ethereum ETFs, boosting institutional access.
FinCEN withdrew proposed digital asset rules, while US plans to seize $1B in Iran-linked crypto.
